parameters.content:
## Event ingest API
`POST /webhook/events`

Accepts one event, an array, or `{"events": [...]}`:
```json
{"case_id":"ORD-1","stage":"received"}
```
Unknown stages and empty IDs are rejected, replays are ignored (`UNIQUE(case_id, stage)`), so the endpoint is safe to retry.

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
    AS x(case_id text, stage text, event_ts timestamptz, source text, payload jsonb)
),
valid AS (
  SELECT i.* FROM incoming i
  JOIN stages s USING (stage)
  WHERE coalesce(i.case_id, '') <> ''
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO process_events (case_id, stage, event_ts, source, payload)
  SELECT case_id, stage, coalesce(event_ts, now()), coalesce(source, 'api'), coalesce(payload, '{}')
  FROM valid
  ON CONFLICT (case_id, stage) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM incoming)                               AS received,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted)                               AS inserted,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM valid) - (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted) AS duplicates,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM incoming) - (SELECT count(*) FROM valid) AS rejected;
